name: San Lorenzo de la Parrilla (Spain)
description: Quartered yellow and red with a blue cross throughout fimbriated white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Lorenzo de la Parrilla (a gridiron, a chequy field and a bull).
history: Municipal flag of San Lorenzo de la Parrilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: San Lorenzo de la Parrilla arms — gridiron, chequy and bull
